original_requirement: Per fixture project, queries with expected files/symbols; measure precision@k and MRR in benchmark-ci.yml. Preserve existing live tier.
observed_missing_behavior: benchmark-ci tests benchmark arithmetic and repeated search stability, but does not index an authored labeled fixture corpus and gate the returned search answers against its expected files.
behavior: Make CI detect lost or badly ranked OciusX-relevant source answers using a fixed authored WebForms/VB, JS/TS and SQL fixture and existing retrieval/metric APIs.
finite_acceptance: Define authored source corpus and expected query/file answers before running retrieval; include plausible distractors and actual business behavior, not implementation-generated expected output.
Use real indexing/search with explicit deterministic backend and owned fixture lifetime; measure distinct-file precision@5 and MRR, preserve actual rankings and named per-query failures.
Freeze useful rank/coverage thresholds before seeing results; a missing relevant result must fail. Do not lower criteria or change labels to match a failed search.
Wire the focused check and its per-query/aggregate report into existing benchmark-ci reporting. Verify locally, commit/push origin/master; distinguish local execution from hosted CI evidence.
scope_guard: OciusX-relevant fixtures only; no unrelated language expansion, CodeMap/Blast evaluation, live OciusX mutation, new benchmark platform or claim of measured productivity.
cleanup: Own fixture directories and close database/server handles before teardown. Retain evidence in this one recorded diagnostics directory; no preexisting deletion.
retained_unfinished: Other accepted original findings and gates; full goal remains active.
